transcription: Morning everyone. Let us go round quickly. What did you work on yesterday and is anything blocking you? I finished the new sign up screens and shared them in the design channel. I am waiting on feedback from marketing. I will chase them today. I tested the password reset flow. I found two bugs, one on mobile and one with expired links. Is the mobile one about the button being hidden behind the keyboard? Yes, exactly. It only happens on smaller phones. Can you two pair on that this morning? I would like both bugs fixed before the demo on Wednesday. Sounds good to me. Sure. Great. Last thing, please update your tickets before lunch so the board is accurate for the planning meeting. Will do. I will also add the steps to reproduce both bugs. And I will attach the updated screens to the sign up ticket.
